findings.evidence: Mathlib has `theorem integrable_measureT {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (-1) 1)) : Integrable f measureT` at `mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Trigonometric/Chebyshev/Orthogonality.lean:67`; the new proofs at lines 32-46 and 62-71 are exactly `integrable_measureT (by fun_prop)` or `.ofReal` specializations.
findings.fix: Remove these wrappers and use `integrable_measureT (by fun_prop)` directly, with `.ofReal` for the `RCLike` cast forms.
findings.issue: The `L¹` declarations `integrable_pow_measureT`, `integrable_eval_measureT`, `integrable_algebraMap_eval_measureT`, `integrable_eval_T_real_measureT`, and `integrable_algebraMap_eval_T_real_measureT` are thin public restatements of Mathlib's `Polynomial.Chebyshev.integrable_measureT`.

findings.evidence: The declarations at lines 62-82 have bodies exactly applying the polynomial lemmas from lines 37-57 to `(T ℝ n)`, so they create parallel API without adding content.
findings.fix: Drop `integrable_eval_T_real_measureT`, `integrable_algebraMap_eval_T_real_measureT`, `memLp_two_eval_T_real_measureT`, and `memLp_two_algebraMap_eval_T_real_measureT`; downstream code can use `integrable_eval_measureT (T ℝ n)`, `integrable_algebraMap_eval_measureT (𝕜 := 𝕜) (T ℝ n)`, `memLp_two_eval_measureT (T ℝ n)`, and `memLp_two_algebraMap_eval_measureT (𝕜 := 𝕜) (T ℝ n)`.
findings.issue: The four Chebyshev-`T` consumer lemmas are duplicate special cases of the polynomial consumer lemmas introduced just above.

summary: The PR adds public Chebyshev integrability wrappers that are direct specializations of existing Mathlib API, plus Chebyshev-`T` special cases already covered by the polynomial lemmas in the same file.
